# Changes in this version

The version previously reviewed omitted landmark main effects from both
supermodels. I added the centered linear and quadratic landmark terms to the
enrollment-time supermodel. I kept them out of the primary attained-age model
after checking that its prediction windows do not overlap and demonstrating
that the Cox partial likelihood cannot estimate those terms on this grid.

I also replaced the coefficient display with robust hazard ratios, confidence
intervals, and Wald tests; fitted a separate cause-specific model at every
landmark; and compared those disjoint fits with the supermodels in coefficients,
precision, and prediction performance. The performance section now separates
apparent estimates from subject-level Harrell-bootstrap optimism correction.

# Purpose

I compared the PBC landmark supermodel on two clocks. The enrollment-time
analysis asked about risk a given number of years after enrollment. The
attained-age analysis asked about risk at a given age. Both used a
`r prediction_window`-year prediction window, the same PBC records, outcome,
laboratory transformations, and non-age predictors.

These are not competing estimates of the same quantity. An enrollment landmark
conditions on survival for a specified time after enrollment; an age landmark
conditions on being observed and event-free at a specified age. The risk sets
and scientific questions therefore differ. A difference between the fitted
models is not bias in either direction.

The age scale is useful when a common time zero has no defensible clinical
meaning, as in a cohort assembled from electronic health records. It also
requires an additional eligibility rule: a person must have entered observation
by the landmark age. I used strict eligibility, `entry <= landmark < exit`, for
that reason.

before setting up the analysis. I then loaded this checkout directly and
inspected the formal arguments from the active functions.

## PBC data returned by the fork

I ran `get_pbc_long()` without modifying its complete-case restriction. The
object returned `time` and `status` for the outcome and `tstart` for the visit
time. Age was already measured in years.

```{r pbc-structure}
pbc_long <- get_pbc_long()
str(pbc_long)
```

# Evidence that bilirubin and albumin were updated

I selected bilirubin and albumin only after checking their within-person
variation. The short extract below shows repeated measurements for subjects
with several visits.

```{r repeated-lab-examples}
visits_per_subject <- table(pbc_long$id)
example_ids <- as.integer(names(head(sort(visits_per_subject, decreasing = TRUE), 3L)))
example_visits <- do.call(rbind, lapply(example_ids, function(subject_id) {
  head(
    pbc_long[pbc_long$id == subject_id, c("id", "tstart", "bili", "albumin")],
    5L
  )
}))
rownames(example_visits) <- NULL

knitr::kable(example_visits, digits = 3)
```

I summarized both the number of visits and the within-person standard
deviations. A subject counted as changing when at least two distinct recorded
values were present.

```{r longitudinal-summaries}
visit_summary <- data.frame(
  statistic = c("Minimum", "First quartile", "Median", "Mean", "Third quartile", "Maximum"),
  visits = as.numeric(c(
    min(visits_per_subject),
    quantile(visits_per_subject, 0.25, names = FALSE, type = 8),
    median(visits_per_subject),
    mean(visits_per_subject),
    quantile(visits_per_subject, 0.75, names = FALSE, type = 8),
    max(visits_per_subject)
  )),
  row.names = NULL
)

summarize_within_person <- function(variable, label) {
  values_by_subject <- split(pbc_long[[variable]], pbc_long$id)
  within_sd <- vapply(values_by_subject, stats::sd, numeric(1L))
  data.frame(
    laboratory = label,
    subjects = length(values_by_subject),
    subjects_with_multiple_visits = sum(lengths(values_by_subject) > 1L),
    subjects_with_change = sum(vapply(
      values_by_subject,
      function(values) length(unique(values)) > 1L,
      logical(1L)
    )),
    median_within_person_sd = median(within_sd, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_quartile_within_person_sd = quantile(within_sd, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE, type = 8),
    third_quartile_within_person_sd = quantile(within_sd, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE, type = 8),
    row.names = NULL
  )
}

laboratory_variation <- rbind(
  summarize_within_person("bili", "Bilirubin"),
  summarize_within_person("albumin", "Albumin")
)

stopifnot(all(laboratory_variation$subjects_with_change > 0L))

knitr::kable(visit_summary, digits = 2)
knitr::kable(laboratory_variation, digits = 3)
```

# Common analysis definitions

I retained the original endpoint: status `r censor_code` was censoring, status
`r transplant_code` was transplant, and status `r cause_of_interest` was death.
I fitted a cause-specific Cox supermodel through `Hist(..., entry)` and
`type = "CSC"`, with death as the event of interest and transplant retained as
the competing event. This avoided changing the outcome when I changed the time
axis.

I log-transformed bilirubin because of its right-skewed scale and standardized
both laboratory measures once, before constructing either landmark stack. The
same transformed values therefore entered both models.

```{r analysis-definitions}
log_bili_center <- mean(log(pbc_long$bili))
log_bili_scale <- sd(log(pbc_long$bili))
albumin_center <- mean(pbc_long$albumin)
albumin_scale <- sd(pbc_long$albumin)

subject_entry_ages <- unique(pbc_long[c("id", "age")])
age_center <- mean(subject_entry_ages$age)
age_scale <- sd(subject_entry_ages$age)

pbc_analysis <- transform(
  pbc_long,
  age_at_enrollment = age,
  log_bili_z = (log(bili) - log_bili_center) / log_bili_scale,
  albumin_z = (albumin - albumin_center) / albumin_scale
)

shared_fixed_covariates <- c("male", "stage", "trt")
updated_laboratory_covariates <- c("log_bili_z", "albumin_z")
shared_model_covariates <- c(shared_fixed_covariates, updated_laboratory_covariates)
enrollment_model_covariates <- c("attained_age_z", shared_model_covariates)
age_model_covariates <- shared_model_covariates

stopifnot(
  identical(
    setdiff(enrollment_model_covariates, "attained_age_z"),
    age_model_covariates
  ),
  all(is.finite(pbc_analysis$log_bili_z)),
  all(is.finite(pbc_analysis$albumin_z))
)

make_landmark_basis <- function(center, half_range) {
  stopifnot(is.finite(center), is.finite(half_range), half_range > 0)
  force(center)
  force(half_range)
  list(
    function(time) (time - center) / half_range,
    function(time) ((time - center) / half_range)^2
  )
}

analysis_constants <- data.frame(
  quantity = c("Prediction window", "Cause of interest", "Enrollment landmarks"),
  value = c(
    paste(prediction_window, "years"),
    paste(cause_of_interest, "(death)"),
    paste(enrollment_landmarks, collapse = ", ")
  ),
  row.names = NULL
)

covariate_contract <- data.frame(
  scale = c("Enrollment time", "Attained age"),
  non_age_covariates = c(
    paste(shared_model_covariates, collapse = ", "),
    paste(shared_model_covariates, collapse = ", ")
  ),
  age_treatment = c(
    "Updated attained age entered as a predictor",
    "Attained age was the time axis and was excluded from the right-hand side"
  ),
  landmark_main_effect = c(
    "Centered linear and quadratic LM terms",
    "Omitted because the non-overlapping windows make LM constant within every risk set"
  ),
  row.names = NULL
)

knitr::kable(analysis_constants)
knitr::kable(covariate_contract)
```

# Landmark selection and risk sets

I chose the age landmarks from the empirical first, second, and third quartiles
of entry age and rounded them to one decimal place. This covered the central
span of entry ages without selecting round ages first and, as the risk-set table
shows, retained deaths and horizon controls at each landmark.

```{r age-landmark-selection}
age_landmark_probabilities <- c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75)
age_landmarks <- round(
  unname(quantile(
    subject_entry_ages$age,
    age_landmark_probabilities,
    type = 8
  )),
  1
)

age_landmark_selection <- data.frame(
  entry_age_percentile = paste0(age_landmark_probabilities * 100, "%"),
  landmark_age = age_landmarks,
  row.names = NULL
)

stopifnot(length(unique(age_landmarks)) == length(age_landmarks))
knitr::kable(age_landmark_selection, digits = 1)
```

```{r landmark-bases}
enrollment_basis <- make_landmark_basis(
  mean(enrollment_landmarks),
  diff(range(enrollment_landmarks)) / 2
)
age_basis <- make_landmark_basis(
  mean(age_landmarks),
  diff(range(age_landmarks)) / 2
)
```

For enrollment time, I carried each person's baseline age forward by the
landmark time. For attained age, I instead shifted the outcome and visit times
onto the age scale and passed entry age to the strict stacker. I did not add age
to the attained-age model's right-hand side.

```{r build-stacks}
enrollment_stack_raw <- stack_data(
  data = pbc_analysis,
  outcome = list(time = "time", status = "status"),
  lms = enrollment_landmarks,
  w = prediction_window,
  covs = list(
    fixed = c(shared_fixed_covariates, "age_at_enrollment"),
    varying = updated_laboratory_covariates
  ),
  format = "long",
  id = "id",
  rtime = "tstart"
)

enrollment_stack_raw$data$attained_age_z <- (
  enrollment_stack_raw$data$age_at_enrollment + enrollment_stack_raw$data$LM - age_center
) / age_scale

pbc_age <- transform(
  pbc_analysis,
  entry_age = age_at_enrollment,
  exit_age = age_at_enrollment + time,
  visit_age = age_at_enrollment + tstart
)

age_stack_raw <- stack_data(
  data = pbc_age,
  outcome = list(time = "exit_age", status = "status"),
  lms = age_landmarks,
  w = prediction_window,
  covs = list(
    fixed = shared_fixed_covariates,
    varying = updated_laboratory_covariates
  ),
  format = "long",
  id = "id",
  rtime = "visit_age",
  entry = "entry_age",
  entry_mode = "strict"
)

stopifnot(
  identical(age_stack_raw$entry_mode, "strict"),
  identical(age_stack_raw$entry_col, "LM"),
  all(age_stack_raw$data$entry_age <= age_stack_raw$data$LM),
  all(age_stack_raw$data$LM < age_stack_raw$data$exit_age),
  !anyDuplicated(age_stack_raw$data[c("id", "LM")]),
  !anyDuplicated(enrollment_stack_raw$data[c("id", "LM")])
)
```

```{r risk-set-table}
summarize_risk_sets <- function(stack, scale_label, time_column) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(split(stack$data, stack$data$LM), function(landmark_data) {
    landmark <- unique(landmark_data$LM)
    stopifnot(length(landmark) == 1L)
    data.frame(
      scale = scale_label,
      landmark = landmark,
      subjects = length(unique(landmark_data$id)),
      deaths = sum(landmark_data$status == cause_of_interest),
      transplants = sum(landmark_data$status == 1L),
      horizon_controls = sum(
        landmark_data$status == 0L &
          landmark_data[[time_column]] >= landmark + prediction_window
      ),
      censorings_before_horizon = sum(
        landmark_data$status == 0L &
          landmark_data[[time_column]] < landmark + prediction_window
      ),
      row.names = NULL
    )
  }))
}

risk_sets <- rbind(
  summarize_risk_sets(enrollment_stack_raw, "Enrollment time", "time"),
  summarize_risk_sets(age_stack_raw, "Attained age", "exit_age")
)

enrollment_risk_counts <- risk_sets$subjects[risk_sets$scale == "Enrollment time"]
age_risk_counts <- risk_sets$subjects[risk_sets$scale == "Attained age"]

stopifnot(
  all(diff(enrollment_risk_counts) <= 0L),
  all(risk_sets$deaths <= risk_sets$subjects),
  all(risk_sets$transplants <= risk_sets$subjects)
)

knitr::kable(risk_sets, digits = 1)
```

The enrollment risk sets decreased monotonically. The attained-age risk sets
did not have to decrease: later landmarks lost people to events and censoring
but could also gain people who entered observation at older ages. This is why a
monotonicity check that is sensible after a shared origin is not an age-scale
eligibility check.

# Model fitting

I allowed the effects of the updated laboratory covariates to vary over a
centered quadratic landmark basis on both clocks. For enrollment time I also
used that basis as `func_lms`, producing the standard LM main effects alongside
the LM-by-laboratory interactions. I did not include LM main effects in the
primary attained-age model because its current prediction windows do not
overlap; the risk-set check below shows why those coefficients are not
identified by the Cox partial likelihood.

```{r add-landmark-interactions}
enrollment_stack <- add_interactions(
  enrollment_stack_raw,
  lm_covs = updated_laboratory_covariates,
  func_covars = enrollment_basis,
  func_lms = enrollment_basis
)
age_stack <- add_interactions(
  age_stack_raw,
  lm_covs = updated_laboratory_covariates,
  func_covars = age_basis,
  func_lms = list()
)

interaction_names <- c(
  "log_bili_z_LM1", "log_bili_z_LM2",
  "albumin_z_LM1", "albumin_z_LM2"
)
enrollment_lm_main_effects <- grep(
  "^LM[0-9]+$", names(enrollment_stack$data), value = TRUE
)

stopifnot(
  identical(enrollment_lm_main_effects, c("LM1", "LM2")),
  all(interaction_names %in% names(enrollment_stack$data)),
  all(interaction_names %in% names(age_stack$data)),
  !any(c("LM1", "LM2") %in% names(age_stack$data))
)

interaction_columns <- data.frame(
  component = c(
    updated_laboratory_covariates,
    rep("Landmark main effect", length(enrollment_lm_main_effects))
  ),
  linear_or_first_basis_column = c(
    paste0(updated_laboratory_covariates, "_LM1"),
    enrollment_lm_main_effects
  ),
  quadratic_or_second_basis_column = c(
    paste0(updated_laboratory_covariates, "_LM2"),
    rep("", length(enrollment_lm_main_effects))
  ),
  scale = c(
    rep("Both", length(updated_laboratory_covariates)),
    rep("Enrollment time only", length(enrollment_lm_main_effects))
  ),
  row.names = NULL
)

knitr::kable(interaction_columns)
```

I used the same cause-specific outcome specification on both scales. Repeated
landmark records were clustered by subject, so all inference below uses the
robust covariance returned by the cause-specific Cox fits.

```{r fit-models}
enrollment_formula <- as.formula(
  paste(
    "Hist(time, status, LM) ~",
    "attained_age_z + male + stage + trt +",
    "log_bili_z + log_bili_z_LM1 + log_bili_z_LM2 +",
    "albumin_z + albumin_z_LM1 + albumin_z_LM2 +",
    "LM1 + LM2 + cluster(id)"
  )
)

age_formula <- as.formula(
  paste(
    "Hist(exit_age, status, LM) ~",
    "male + stage + trt +",
    "log_bili_z + log_bili_z_LM1 + log_bili_z_LM2 +",
    "albumin_z + albumin_z_LM1 + albumin_z_LM2 + cluster(id)"
  )
)

capture_conditions <- function(expression) {
  warnings <- character()
  messages <- character()
  value <- withCallingHandlers(
    tryCatch(eval.parent(substitute(expression)), error = function(error) error),
    warning = function(warning) {
      warnings <<- c(warnings, conditionMessage(warning))
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    },
    message = function(message) {
      messages <<- c(messages, conditionMessage(message))
      invokeRestart("muffleMessage")
    }
  )
  list(value = value, warnings = unique(warnings), messages = unique(messages))
}

enrollment_fit_record <- capture_conditions(dynamic_lm(
  enrollment_stack,
  enrollment_formula,
  type = "CSC",
  method = "breslow",
  x = TRUE
))
age_fit_record <- capture_conditions(dynamic_lm(
  age_stack,
  age_formula,
  type = "CSC",
  method = "breslow",
  x = TRUE
))

fit_condition_table <- data.frame(
  scale = c("Enrollment time", "Attained age"),
  warning_count = c(
    length(enrollment_fit_record$warnings),
    length(age_fit_record$warnings)
  ),
  error = c(
    if (inherits(enrollment_fit_record$value, "error")) conditionMessage(enrollment_fit_record$value) else "",
    if (inherits(age_fit_record$value, "error")) conditionMessage(age_fit_record$value) else ""
  ),
  row.names = NULL
)

knitr::kable(fit_condition_table)

stopifnot(
  !inherits(enrollment_fit_record$value, "error"),
  !inherits(age_fit_record$value, "error"),
  length(enrollment_fit_record$warnings) == 0L,
  length(age_fit_record$warnings) == 0L
)

enrollment_fit <- enrollment_fit_record$value
age_fit <- age_fit_record$value
```

## Why the primary age model has no LM main effect

The age windows were disjoint, whereas the enrollment windows overlapped. I
checked both the window endpoints and the actual partial-likelihood risk sets.
At each attained-age event time, every at-risk stacked row came from the same
landmark. The LM value was therefore constant within that risk set and could
not change any partial-likelihood probability. Enrollment-time event risk sets
contained rows from several landmarks, so its centered LM terms were
estimable.

```{r landmark-identifiability-check}
summarize_adjacent_windows <- function(landmarks, scale_label) {
  data.frame(
    scale = scale_label,
    earlier_landmark = head(landmarks, -1L),
    earlier_window_end = head(landmarks, -1L) + prediction_window,
    later_landmark = tail(landmarks, -1L),
    overlaps = tail(landmarks, -1L) <= head(landmarks, -1L) + prediction_window,
    row.names = NULL
  )
}

window_overlap <- rbind(
  summarize_adjacent_windows(enrollment_landmarks, "Enrollment time"),
  summarize_adjacent_windows(age_landmarks, "Attained age")
)

risk_set_landmark_counts <- function(stack, time_column, scale_label) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(sort(unique(stack$data$status[stack$data$status > 0L])), function(cause) {
    event_times <- sort(unique(
      stack$data[[time_column]][stack$data$status == cause]
    ))
    counts <- vapply(event_times, function(event_time) {
      at_risk <- stack$data$LM < event_time & stack$data[[time_column]] >= event_time
      length(unique(stack$data$LM[at_risk]))
    }, integer(1L))
    stopifnot(length(counts) == length(event_times), all(counts >= 1L))
    data.frame(
      scale = scale_label,
      cause = cause,
      event_times = length(event_times),
      minimum_LM_values_in_risk_set = min(counts),
      maximum_LM_values_in_risk_set = max(counts),
      event_times_with_multiple_LM_values = sum(counts > 1L),
      row.names = NULL
    )
  }))
}

risk_set_lm_check <- rbind(
  risk_set_landmark_counts(enrollment_stack_raw, "time", "Enrollment time"),
  risk_set_landmark_counts(age_stack_raw, "exit_age", "Attained age")
)

stopifnot(
  any(window_overlap$overlaps[window_overlap$scale == "Enrollment time"]),
  !any(window_overlap$overlaps[window_overlap$scale == "Attained age"]),
  all(risk_set_lm_check$maximum_LM_values_in_risk_set[
    risk_set_lm_check$scale == "Attained age"
  ] == 1L),
  any(risk_set_lm_check$maximum_LM_values_in_risk_set[
    risk_set_lm_check$scale == "Enrollment time"
  ] > 1L)
)

knitr::kable(window_overlap, digits = 1)
knitr::kable(risk_set_lm_check)
```

I also fitted the deliberately over-specified age model from a fresh stack.
This was a diagnostic fit only; none of its coefficients or predictions were
used later.

```{r age-lm-main-effect-demonstration}
age_stack_lm_demo <- add_interactions(
  age_stack_raw,
  lm_covs = updated_laboratory_covariates,
  func_covars = age_basis,
  func_lms = age_basis
)
age_lm_demo_formula <- update(age_formula, . ~ . + LM1 + LM2)
age_lm_demo_record <- capture_conditions(dynamic_lm(
  age_stack_lm_demo,
  age_lm_demo_formula,
  type = "CSC",
  method = "breslow",
  x = TRUE
))

age_lm_demo_condition <- data.frame(
  warning_count = length(age_lm_demo_record$warnings),
  warnings = paste(age_lm_demo_record$warnings, collapse = " | "),
  error = if (inherits(age_lm_demo_record$value, "error")) {
    conditionMessage(age_lm_demo_record$value)
  } else "",
  row.names = NULL
)
knitr::kable(age_lm_demo_condition)

if (inherits(age_lm_demo_record$value, "error")) {
  age_lm_demo_coefficients <- data.frame(
    cause = NA_integer_, term = c("LM1", "LM2"), estimate = NA_real_,
    robust_standard_error = NA_real_, result = "fit failed"
  )
} else {
  age_lm_demo_coefficients <- do.call(rbind, lapply(
    age_lm_demo_record$value$model$causes,
    function(cause) {
      cause_fit <- age_lm_demo_record$value$model$models[[
        match(cause, age_lm_demo_record$value$model$causes)
      ]]
      terms <- c("LM1", "LM2")
      estimates <- coef(cause_fit)[terms]
      standard_errors <- sqrt(diag(vcov(cause_fit)))[terms]
      data.frame(
        cause = cause,
        term = terms,
        estimate = unname(estimates),
        robust_standard_error = unname(standard_errors),
        result = ifelse(
          is.finite(estimates) & is.finite(standard_errors) & standard_errors > 0,
          "estimable", "non-estimable"
        ),
        row.names = NULL
      )
    }
  ))
  stopifnot(all(age_lm_demo_coefficients$result == "non-estimable"))
}

knitr::kable(age_lm_demo_coefficients, digits = 4)
```

# Full supermodel coefficient comparison

The interaction bases sit on different clocks, so their coefficients are not
contrasts. I displayed every death-model term to make the two fitted
specifications transparent. The dashes identify terms that are structurally
absent from the primary attained-age model.

```{r full-coefficient-table}
extract_cause_fit <- function(supermodel, cause) {
  cause_index <- match(cause, supermodel$model$causes)
  stopifnot(!is.na(cause_index))
  supermodel$model$models[[cause_index]]
}

extract_robust_inference <- function(supermodel, cause = cause_of_interest) {
  cause_fit <- extract_cause_fit(supermodel, cause)
  estimates <- coef(cause_fit)
  robust_standard_errors <- sqrt(diag(vcov(cause_fit)))
  summary_coefficients <- summary(cause_fit)$coefficients
  stopifnot(
    "robust se" %in% colnames(summary_coefficients),
    identical(names(estimates), rownames(summary_coefficients)),
    max(abs(
      robust_standard_errors - summary_coefficients[, "robust se"]
    ), na.rm = TRUE) < 1e-12
  )
  critical_value <- qnorm(1 - (1 - confidence_level) / 2)
  data.frame(
    term = names(estimates),
    estimate = unname(estimates),
    robust_standard_error = unname(robust_standard_errors),
    lower = unname(estimates - critical_value * robust_standard_errors),
    upper = unname(estimates + critical_value * robust_standard_errors),
    hazard_ratio = exp(unname(estimates)),
    hazard_ratio_lower = exp(unname(estimates - critical_value * robust_standard_errors)),
    hazard_ratio_upper = exp(unname(estimates + critical_value * robust_standard_errors)),
    p_value = 2 * pnorm(-abs(unname(estimates / robust_standard_errors))),
    row.names = NULL
  )
}

enrollment_coefficients <- extract_robust_inference(enrollment_fit)
age_coefficients <- extract_robust_inference(age_fit)

full_term_order <- c(
  "attained_age_z", "male", "stage", "trt",
  "log_bili_z", "log_bili_z_LM1", "log_bili_z_LM2",
  "albumin_z", "albumin_z_LM1", "albumin_z_LM2", "LM1", "LM2"
)
term_labels <- c(
  attained_age_z = "Attained age (per SD)",
  male = "Male", stage = "Disease stage", trt = "Treatment",
  log_bili_z = "Log bilirubin (per SD)",
  log_bili_z_LM1 = "Log bilirubin x LM basis 1",
  log_bili_z_LM2 = "Log bilirubin x LM basis 2",
  albumin_z = "Albumin (per SD)",
  albumin_z_LM1 = "Albumin x LM basis 1",
  albumin_z_LM2 = "Albumin x LM basis 2",
  LM1 = "LM basis 1", LM2 = "LM basis 2"
)

format_hr_ci <- function(inference, term) {
  index <- match(term, inference$term)
  if (is.na(index) || !is.finite(inference$hazard_ratio[index])) return("—")
  sprintf(
    "%.3f (%.3f, %.3f)",
    inference$hazard_ratio[index],
    inference$hazard_ratio_lower[index],
    inference$hazard_ratio_upper[index]
  )
}
format_p_value <- function(inference, term) {
  index <- match(term, inference$term)
  if (is.na(index) || !is.finite(inference$p_value[index])) return("—")
  format.pval(inference$p_value[index], digits = 3, eps = 0.001)
}

coefficient_comparison <- data.frame(
  term = unname(term_labels[full_term_order]),
  enrollment_HR_95_CI = vapply(
    full_term_order, function(term) format_hr_ci(enrollment_coefficients, term),
    character(1L)
  ),
  enrollment_robust_Wald_p = vapply(
    full_term_order, function(term) format_p_value(enrollment_coefficients, term),
    character(1L)
  ),
  attained_age_HR_95_CI = vapply(
    full_term_order, function(term) format_hr_ci(age_coefficients, term),
    character(1L)
  ),
  attained_age_robust_Wald_p = vapply(
    full_term_order, function(term) format_p_value(age_coefficients, term),
    character(1L)
  ),
  row.names = NULL
)

stopifnot(
  all(c("attained_age_z", "LM1", "LM2") %in% enrollment_coefficients$term),
  !any(c("attained_age_z", "LM1", "LM2") %in% age_coefficients$term)
)

knitr::kable(coefficient_comparison, align = c("l", "c", "c", "c", "c"))
```

The landmark-specific laboratory table combines each main effect with its two
interaction coefficients. Its confidence intervals use the delta method and
the same robust covariance matrix as the full coefficient table.

```{r landmark-specific-supermodel-hazard-ratios}
dynamic_log_hazard_ratio <- function(supermodel, marker, landmarks, basis) {
  cause_fit <- extract_cause_fit(supermodel, cause_of_interest)
  marker_terms <- c(marker, paste0(marker, "_LM1"), paste0(marker, "_LM2"))
  stopifnot(all(marker_terms %in% names(coef(cause_fit))))
  design <- cbind(1, basis[[1L]](landmarks), basis[[2L]](landmarks))
  coefficients <- coef(cause_fit)[marker_terms]
  covariance <- vcov(cause_fit)[marker_terms, marker_terms, drop = FALSE]
  estimate <- as.numeric(design %*% coefficients)
  standard_error <- sqrt(rowSums((design %*% covariance) * design))
  critical_value <- qnorm(1 - (1 - confidence_level) / 2)
  data.frame(
    landmark = landmarks,
    estimate = estimate,
    standard_error = standard_error,
    lower = estimate - critical_value * standard_error,
    upper = estimate + critical_value * standard_error,
    row.names = NULL
  )
}

landmark_specific_supermodel_hr <- do.call(rbind, list(
  transform(
    dynamic_log_hazard_ratio(enrollment_fit, "log_bili_z", enrollment_landmarks, enrollment_basis),
    scale = "Enrollment time", covariate = "Log bilirubin (per SD)"
  ),
  transform(
    dynamic_log_hazard_ratio(enrollment_fit, "albumin_z", enrollment_landmarks, enrollment_basis),
    scale = "Enrollment time", covariate = "Albumin (per SD)"
  ),
  transform(
    dynamic_log_hazard_ratio(age_fit, "log_bili_z", age_landmarks, age_basis),
    scale = "Attained age", covariate = "Log bilirubin (per SD)"
  ),
  transform(
    dynamic_log_hazard_ratio(age_fit, "albumin_z", age_landmarks, age_basis),
    scale = "Attained age", covariate = "Albumin (per SD)"
  )
))
landmark_specific_supermodel_hr$HR_95_CI <- sprintf(
  "%.3f (%.3f, %.3f)",
  exp(landmark_specific_supermodel_hr$estimate),
  exp(landmark_specific_supermodel_hr$lower),
  exp(landmark_specific_supermodel_hr$upper)
)

knitr::kable(
  landmark_specific_supermodel_hr[c("scale", "landmark", "covariate", "HR_95_CI")],
  digits = 1
)
```

# Disjoint landmark models

I fitted a separate competing-risk model at each landmark using the same risk
set, endpoint, window, and substantive covariates as its supermodel. These fits
had no LM terms or interactions. The enrollment disjoint models retained
updated attained age. I did not alter a model to suppress instability.

```{r disjoint-model-fits}
subset_lmdata <- function(lmdata, landmark) {
  out <- lmdata
  out$data <- lmdata$data[lmdata$data$LM == landmark, , drop = FALSE]
  out$end_time <- landmark
  stopifnot(nrow(out$data) > 0L, all(out$data$LM == landmark))
  out
}

enrollment_disjoint_formula <- as.formula(
  paste(
    "Hist(time, status, LM) ~",
    "attained_age_z + male + stage + trt + log_bili_z + albumin_z + cluster(id)"
  )
)
age_disjoint_formula <- as.formula(
  paste(
    "Hist(exit_age, status, LM) ~",
    "male + stage + trt + log_bili_z + albumin_z + cluster(id)"
  )
)

fit_disjoint_models <- function(lmdata, landmarks, formula, time_column, scale_label) {
  records <- setNames(vector("list", length(landmarks)), as.character(landmarks))
  model_diagnostic_rows <- list()
  diagnostic_rows <- list()
  rhs <- paste(deparse(formula[[3L]]), collapse = "")

  for (landmark in landmarks) {
    one_landmark <- subset_lmdata(lmdata, landmark)
    model_record <- capture_conditions(dynamic_lm(
      one_landmark, formula, type = "CSC", method = "breslow", x = TRUE
    ))
    records[[as.character(landmark)]] <- model_record
    model_diagnostic_rows[[length(model_diagnostic_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      scale = scale_label,
      landmark = landmark,
      warning_count = length(model_record$warnings),
      warnings = paste(model_record$warnings, collapse = " | "),
      error = if (inherits(model_record$value, "error")) {
        conditionMessage(model_record$value)
      } else "",
      row.names = NULL
    )

    for (cause in c(transplant_code, cause_of_interest)) {
      direct_formula <- as.formula(paste0(
        "Surv(LM, ", time_column, ", status == ", cause, ") ~ ", rhs
      ))
      direct_record <- capture_conditions(survival::coxph(
        direct_formula, data = one_landmark$data, method = "breslow", x = TRUE
      ))
      outer_error <- if (inherits(model_record$value, "error")) {
        conditionMessage(model_record$value)
      } else ""
      direct_error <- if (inherits(direct_record$value, "error")) {
        conditionMessage(direct_record$value)
      } else ""
      nonestimable <- character()

      if (!inherits(model_record$value, "error")) {
        cause_fit <- extract_cause_fit(model_record$value, cause)
        nonestimable <- names(coef(cause_fit))[!is.finite(coef(cause_fit))]
        if (!inherits(direct_record$value, "error")) {
          common_terms <- intersect(names(coef(cause_fit)), names(coef(direct_record$value)))
          finite_terms <- common_terms[
            is.finite(coef(cause_fit)[common_terms]) &
              is.finite(coef(direct_record$value)[common_terms])
          ]
          if (length(finite_terms)) {
            stopifnot(max(abs(
              coef(cause_fit)[finite_terms] - coef(direct_record$value)[finite_terms]
            )) < 1e-8)
          }
        }
      }

      diagnostic_rows[[length(diagnostic_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
        scale = scale_label,
        landmark = landmark,
        cause = cause,
        warning_count = length(direct_record$warnings),
        warnings = paste(direct_record$warnings, collapse = " | "),
        error = paste(c(outer_error, direct_error)[nzchar(c(outer_error, direct_error))], collapse = " | "),
        nonestimable_terms = paste(nonestimable, collapse = ", "),
        row.names = NULL
      )
    }
  }

  list(
    records = records,
    model_diagnostics = do.call(rbind, model_diagnostic_rows),
    diagnostics = do.call(rbind, diagnostic_rows)
  )
}

enrollment_disjoint <- fit_disjoint_models(
  enrollment_stack_raw, enrollment_landmarks, enrollment_disjoint_formula,
  "time", "Enrollment time"
)
age_disjoint <- fit_disjoint_models(
  age_stack_raw, age_landmarks, age_disjoint_formula,
  "exit_age", "Attained age"
)
disjoint_diagnostics <- rbind(
  enrollment_disjoint$diagnostics,
  age_disjoint$diagnostics
)
disjoint_model_diagnostics <- rbind(
  enrollment_disjoint$model_diagnostics,
  age_disjoint$model_diagnostics
)

knitr::kable(
  disjoint_model_diagnostics, digits = 1,
  caption = "Warnings and errors returned by each competing-risk model"
)
knitr::kable(
  disjoint_diagnostics, digits = 1,
  caption = "Cause-specific warnings, errors, and non-estimable coefficients"
)
```

## Supermodel and disjoint estimates

The long comparison table keeps sample size and both event types beside every
estimate. `fit_flag` reports any death-model warning, failure, or
non-estimability rather than silently dropping an affected estimate.

```{r disjoint-coefficient-comparison}
get_disjoint_record <- function(disjoint_result, landmark) {
  index <- which(abs(as.numeric(names(disjoint_result$records)) - landmark) < 1e-8)
  stopifnot(length(index) == 1L)
  disjoint_result$records[[index]]
}

supermodel_effect <- function(supermodel, covariate, landmark, basis) {
  if (covariate %in% updated_laboratory_covariates) {
    dynamic_log_hazard_ratio(supermodel, covariate, landmark, basis)
  } else {
    inference <- extract_robust_inference(supermodel)
    row <- inference[inference$term == covariate, ]
    stopifnot(nrow(row) == 1L)
    data.frame(
      landmark = landmark, estimate = row$estimate,
      standard_error = row$robust_standard_error,
      lower = row$lower, upper = row$upper
    )
  }
}

disjoint_effect <- function(disjoint_result, landmark, covariate) {
  record <- get_disjoint_record(disjoint_result, landmark)
  if (inherits(record$value, "error")) {
    return(data.frame(
      estimate = NA_real_, standard_error = NA_real_,
      lower = NA_real_, upper = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  inference <- extract_robust_inference(record$value)
  row <- inference[inference$term == covariate, ]
  if (!nrow(row)) {
    return(data.frame(
      estimate = NA_real_, standard_error = NA_real_,
      lower = NA_real_, upper = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  out <- row[c("estimate", "robust_standard_error", "lower", "upper")]
  names(out)[names(out) == "robust_standard_error"] <- "standard_error"
  out
}

comparison_specifications <- list(
  list(
    scale = "Enrollment time", landmarks = enrollment_landmarks,
    supermodel = enrollment_fit, disjoint = enrollment_disjoint,
    basis = enrollment_basis,
    covariates = c("attained_age_z", shared_model_covariates)
  ),
  list(
    scale = "Attained age", landmarks = age_landmarks,
    supermodel = age_fit, disjoint = age_disjoint,
    basis = age_basis, covariates = shared_model_covariates
  )
)

comparison_rows <- list()
for (specification in comparison_specifications) {
  for (landmark in specification$landmarks) {
    counts <- risk_sets[
      risk_sets$scale == specification$scale & risk_sets$landmark == landmark,
    ]
    stopifnot(nrow(counts) == 1L)
    diagnostics <- specification$disjoint$diagnostics[
      specification$disjoint$diagnostics$landmark == landmark &
        specification$disjoint$diagnostics$cause == cause_of_interest,
    ]
    stopifnot(nrow(diagnostics) == 1L)

    for (covariate in specification$covariates) {
      supermodel_row <- supermodel_effect(
        specification$supermodel, covariate, landmark, specification$basis
      )
      disjoint_row <- disjoint_effect(
        specification$disjoint, landmark, covariate
      )
      flags <- c(
        if (nzchar(diagnostics$error)) "fit failure" else character(),
        if (diagnostics$warning_count > 0L) "warning" else character(),
        if (!is.finite(disjoint_row$estimate) ||
            !is.finite(disjoint_row$standard_error)) "non-estimable" else character()
      )
      comparison_rows[[length(comparison_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
        scale = specification$scale,
        landmark = landmark,
        subjects = counts$subjects,
        deaths = counts$deaths,
        transplants = counts$transplants,
        covariate = covariate,
        supermodel_estimate = supermodel_row$estimate,
        supermodel_standard_error = supermodel_row$standard_error,
        supermodel_lower = supermodel_row$lower,
        supermodel_upper = supermodel_row$upper,
        disjoint_estimate = disjoint_row$estimate,
        disjoint_standard_error = disjoint_row$standard_error,
        disjoint_lower = disjoint_row$lower,
        disjoint_upper = disjoint_row$upper,
        fit_flag = if (length(flags)) paste(unique(flags), collapse = "; ") else "ok",
        row.names = NULL
      )
    }
  }
}
disjoint_comparison <- do.call(rbind, comparison_rows)
disjoint_comparison$supermodel_HR_95_CI <- sprintf(
  "%.3f (%.3f, %.3f)",
  exp(disjoint_comparison$supermodel_estimate),
  exp(disjoint_comparison$supermodel_lower),
  exp(disjoint_comparison$supermodel_upper)
)
disjoint_comparison$disjoint_HR_95_CI <- ifelse(
  is.finite(disjoint_comparison$disjoint_estimate),
  sprintf(
    "%.3f (%.3f, %.3f)",
    exp(disjoint_comparison$disjoint_estimate),
    exp(disjoint_comparison$disjoint_lower),
    exp(disjoint_comparison$disjoint_upper)
  ),
  "—"
)
disjoint_comparison$CI_width_ratio_log_scale <- (
  disjoint_comparison$disjoint_upper - disjoint_comparison$disjoint_lower
) / (
  disjoint_comparison$supermodel_upper - disjoint_comparison$supermodel_lower
)

covariate_labels <- c(term_labels, log_bili_z = "Log bilirubin (per SD)",
                      albumin_z = "Albumin (per SD)")
comparison_display <- transform(
  disjoint_comparison,
  covariate = unname(covariate_labels[covariate])
)

knitr::kable(
  comparison_display[c(
    "scale", "landmark", "subjects", "deaths", "transplants", "covariate",
    "supermodel_HR_95_CI", "disjoint_HR_95_CI",
    "CI_width_ratio_log_scale", "fit_flag"
  )],
  digits = 2
)
```

I measured efficiency on the log-HR scale, where confidence-interval width is
proportional to the robust standard error. The spread table describes how far
the separate landmark estimates moved across each scale.

```{r disjoint-efficiency-summary}
efficiency_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(
  split(disjoint_comparison, list(
    disjoint_comparison$scale, disjoint_comparison$covariate
  ), drop = TRUE),
  function(rows) {
    finite <- is.finite(rows$disjoint_estimate)
    data.frame(
      scale = rows$scale[1L],
      covariate = unname(covariate_labels[rows$covariate[1L]]),
      estimable_landmarks = sum(finite),
      disjoint_log_HR_range = if (any(finite)) {
        diff(range(rows$disjoint_estimate[finite]))
      } else NA_real_,
      disjoint_log_HR_SD = if (sum(finite) > 1L) {
        sd(rows$disjoint_estimate[finite])
      } else NA_real_,
      median_CI_width_ratio = median(
        rows$CI_width_ratio_log_scale[finite], na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      maximum_CI_width_ratio = max(
        rows$CI_width_ratio_log_scale[finite], na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      row.names = NULL
    )
  }
))
rownames(efficiency_summary) <- NULL
knitr::kable(efficiency_summary, digits = 3)
```

## Supermodel curves and disjoint estimates

The points and error bars are the separate landmark fits. The line and grey
band are the supermodel estimate and robust confidence interval. I used the same
vertical scale within each panel, so instability is visible rather than
rescaled away.

```{r dynamic-log-hazard-ratios, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
plot_effect_comparison <- function(curve, disjoint_rows, title, x_label,
                                   y_label = "Log hazard ratio") {
  plot_range <- range(
    curve$lower, curve$upper,
    disjoint_rows$disjoint_lower, disjoint_rows$disjoint_upper,
    finite = TRUE
  )
  plot(
    curve$landmark, curve$estimate, type = "n",
    xlab = x_label, ylab = y_label, main = title, ylim = plot_range
  )
  polygon(
    c(curve$landmark, rev(curve$landmark)),
    c(curve$lower, rev(curve$upper)),
    border = NA, col = "grey85"
  )
  abline(h = 0, lty = 2, col = "grey45")
  lines(curve$landmark, curve$estimate, lwd = 2)
  finite <- is.finite(disjoint_rows$disjoint_estimate) &
    is.finite(disjoint_rows$disjoint_lower) &
    is.finite(disjoint_rows$disjoint_upper)
  arrows(
    disjoint_rows$landmark[finite], disjoint_rows$disjoint_lower[finite],
    disjoint_rows$landmark[finite], disjoint_rows$disjoint_upper[finite],
    angle = 90, code = 3, length = 0.04
  )
  points(
    disjoint_rows$landmark[finite],
    disjoint_rows$disjoint_estimate[finite], pch = 19
  )
}

  ),
  age_albumin = dynamic_log_hazard_ratio(
    age_fit, "albumin_z", age_grid, age_basis
  )
)
```

The fixed-effect panels make the pooling distinction explicit. The
enrollment and age supermodels each use one effect for these covariates, while
the disjoint estimates spend a separate coefficient at every landmark.

```{r fixed-effect-supermodel-disjoint, fig.width=11, fig.height=7}
constant_effect_curve <- function(supermodel, covariate, grid) {
  row <- extract_robust_inference(supermodel)
  row <- row[row$term == covariate, ]
  stopifnot(nrow(row) == 1L)
  data.frame(
    landmark = grid,
    estimate = row$estimate,
    lower = row$lower,
    upper = row$upper
  )
}

old_parameters <- par(mfrow = c(2, 3), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1))
for (scale_label in c("Enrollment time", "Attained age")) {
  supermodel <- if (scale_label == "Enrollment time") enrollment_fit else age_fit
  grid <- if (scale_label == "Enrollment time") enrollment_grid else age_grid
  x_label <- if (scale_label == "Enrollment time") "Years after enrollment" else "Attained age"
  for (covariate in shared_fixed_covariates) {
    plot_effect_comparison(
      constant_effect_curve(supermodel, covariate, grid),
      disjoint_comparison[
        disjoint_comparison$scale == scale_label &
          disjoint_comparison$covariate == covariate, ],
      paste(unname(term_labels[covariate]), scale_label, sep = ": "),
      x_label
    )
  }
}
par(old_parameters)
```

# Predictive performance

I first computed apparent performance on the exact rows used for model fitting.
I then estimated Harrell's bootstrap optimism by resampling subjects, rebuilding
every stack, refitting both supermodels and every disjoint model, and evaluating
each bootstrap fit in both its resample and the original cohort. Duplicated
subjects received new identifiers, so clustering never treated two bootstrap
copies as the same person.

## Apparent landmark-specific performance

```{r predictions-and-scores}
prediction_key <- function(data) {
  paste(data$id, sprintf("%.12g", data$LM), sep = "::")
}

align_prediction <- function(prediction, target_stack) {
  target_key <- prediction_key(target_stack$data)
  source_key <- prediction_key(prediction$data)
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(target_key), !anyDuplicated(source_key))
  index <- match(target_key, source_key)
  stopifnot(!anyNA(index))
  prediction$data <- prediction$data[index, , drop = FALSE]
  prediction$preds <- prediction$preds[index, , drop = FALSE]
  stopifnot(identical(prediction_key(prediction$data), target_key))
  prediction
}

subset_prediction <- function(prediction, landmark) {
  index <- prediction$data$LM == landmark
  out <- prediction
  out$data <- prediction$data[index, , drop = FALSE]
  out$preds <- prediction$preds[index, , drop = FALSE]
  stopifnot(nrow(out$data) == nrow(out$preds), nrow(out$data) > 0L)
  out
}

predict_disjoint_by_landmark <- function(disjoint_result, target_stack,
                                         landmarks) {
  setNames(lapply(landmarks, function(landmark) {
    record <- get_disjoint_record(disjoint_result, landmark)
    if (inherits(record$value, "error")) return(record$value)
    target <- subset_lmdata(target_stack, landmark)
    prediction_record <- capture_conditions(predict(
      record$value, newdata = target, cause = cause_of_interest
    ))
    prediction_record$value
  }), as.character(landmarks))
}

enrollment_prediction_record <- capture_conditions(predict(
  enrollment_fit, newdata = enrollment_stack, cause = cause_of_interest
))
age_prediction_record <- capture_conditions(predict(
  age_fit, newdata = age_stack, cause = cause_of_interest
))
enrollment_disjoint_prediction_records <- predict_disjoint_by_landmark(
  enrollment_disjoint, enrollment_stack_raw, enrollment_landmarks
)
age_disjoint_prediction_records <- predict_disjoint_by_landmark(
  age_disjoint, age_stack_raw, age_landmarks
)

prediction_records <- list(
  enrollment_prediction_record,
  age_prediction_record
)
stopifnot(
  !any(vapply(prediction_records, function(record) {
    inherits(record$value, "error")
  }, logical(1L))),
  all(vapply(prediction_records, function(record) {
    length(record$warnings) == 0L
  }, logical(1L)))
)

enrollment_predictions <- align_prediction(
  enrollment_prediction_record$value, enrollment_stack
)
age_predictions <- align_prediction(age_prediction_record$value, age_stack)

score_predictions_by_landmark <- function(super_prediction,
                                          disjoint_predictions,
                                          landmarks, scale_label) {
  rows <- list()
  failures <- list()
  for (landmark in landmarks) {
    super_one <- subset_prediction(super_prediction, landmark)
    model_list <- list(Supermodel = super_one)
    disjoint_one <- disjoint_predictions[[as.character(landmark)]]
    if (inherits(disjoint_one, "error")) {
      failures[[length(failures) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
        scale = scale_label, landmark = landmark, method = "Disjoint",
        stage = "prediction", error = conditionMessage(disjoint_one)
      )
    } else {
      stopifnot(identical(
        prediction_key(super_one$data), prediction_key(disjoint_one$data)
      ))
      disjoint_one$data <- super_one$data
      model_list$Disjoint <- disjoint_one
    }
    score_record <- capture_conditions(score(
      model_list, times = landmark, metrics = c("auc", "brier"),
      id_col = "id", cause = cause_of_interest,
      summary = FALSE, contrasts = FALSE
    ))
    if (inherits(score_record$value, "error")) {
      failures[[length(failures) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
        scale = scale_label, landmark = landmark, method = "All available",
        stage = "score", error = conditionMessage(score_record$value)
      )
      next
    }
    auc <- as.data.frame(score_record$value$AUC$score)
    brier <- as.data.frame(score_record$value$Brier$score)
    auc$model <- as.character(auc$model)
    brier$model <- as.character(brier$model)
    available <- names(model_list)
    auc <- auc[auc$model %in% available, c("model", "AUC")]
    brier <- brier[brier$model %in% available, c("model", "Brier")]
    metric <- merge(auc, brier, by = "model", sort = FALSE)
    rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- transform(
      metric, scale = scale_label, landmark = landmark
    )[c("scale", "landmark", "model", "AUC", "Brier")]
  }
  list(
    score = if (length(rows)) do.call(rbind, rows) else NULL,
    failures = if (length(failures)) do.call(rbind, failures) else data.frame()
  )
}

enrollment_apparent <- score_predictions_by_landmark(
  enrollment_predictions, enrollment_disjoint_prediction_records,
  enrollment_landmarks, "Enrollment time"
)
age_apparent <- score_predictions_by_landmark(
  age_predictions, age_disjoint_prediction_records,
  age_landmarks, "Attained age"
)
ordinary_apparent_scores <- rbind(
  enrollment_apparent$score, age_apparent$score
)
apparent_prediction_failures <- rbind(
  enrollment_apparent$failures, age_apparent$failures
)

age_landmark_score_record <- capture_conditions(score(
  list("Age scale" = age_predictions),
  times = age_landmarks, metrics = c("auc", "brier"),
  id_col = "id", cause = cause_of_interest,
  summary = FALSE, contrasts = FALSE
))
stopifnot(!inherits(age_landmark_score_record$value, "error"))
```

Before selecting a common scoring path, I checked `score_left_truncated()`
against `score()` for both methods on both scales.

```{r scoring-function-agreement}
score_lt_by_landmark <- function(super_prediction, disjoint_predictions,
                                 landmarks, scale_label, time_column) {
  rows <- list()
  for (landmark in landmarks) {
    predictions <- list(
      Supermodel = subset_prediction(super_prediction, landmark),
      Disjoint = disjoint_predictions[[as.character(landmark)]]
    )
    predictions <- predictions[!vapply(predictions, inherits, logical(1L), what = "error")]
    for (method in names(predictions)) {
      prediction <- predictions[[method]]
      record <- capture_conditions(score_left_truncated(
        risk = setNames(data.frame(prediction$preds$risk), method),
        data = prediction$data,
        time_col = time_column, status_col = "status", entry_col = "LM",
        landmark_col = "LM", id_col = "id", cause = cause_of_interest,
        w = prediction_window
      ))
      if (!inherits(record$value, "error")) {
        row <- record$value$score
        row$scale <- scale_label
        rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- row[c(
          "scale", "landmark", "model", "AUC", "Brier"
        )]
      }
    }
  }
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

left_truncated_apparent_scores <- rbind(
  score_lt_by_landmark(
    enrollment_predictions, enrollment_disjoint_prediction_records,
    enrollment_landmarks, "Enrollment time", "time"
  ),
  score_lt_by_landmark(
    age_predictions, age_disjoint_prediction_records,
    age_landmarks, "Attained age", "exit_age"
  )
)

score_comparison <- merge(
  ordinary_apparent_scores,
  left_truncated_apparent_scores[c("scale", "landmark", "model", "AUC", "Brier")],
  by = c("scale", "landmark", "model"),
  suffixes = c("_score", "_score_left_truncated"),
  sort = FALSE
)
score_agreement <- do.call(rbind, lapply(
  split(score_comparison, list(score_comparison$scale, score_comparison$model), drop = TRUE),
  function(rows) {
    data.frame(
      scale = rows$scale[1L], model = rows$model[1L],
      maximum_AUC_difference = max(abs(
        rows$AUC_score - rows$AUC_score_left_truncated
      )),
      maximum_Brier_difference = max(abs(
        rows$Brier_score - rows$Brier_score_left_truncated
      )),
      row.names = NULL
    )
  }
))
rownames(score_agreement) <- NULL

agreement_tolerance <- 1e-12
stopifnot(all(
  score_agreement$maximum_AUC_difference[
    score_agreement$scale == "Attained age"
  ] < agreement_tolerance &
    score_agreement$maximum_Brier_difference[
      score_agreement$scale == "Attained age"
    ] < agreement_tolerance
))
all_paths_agree <- all(
  score_agreement$maximum_AUC_difference < agreement_tolerance &
    score_agreement$maximum_Brier_difference < agreement_tolerance
)
scoring_decision <- if (all_paths_agree) {
  "The two functions agreed on both scales, so I used score_left_truncated() for the comparison."
} else {
  paste(
    "The functions did not agree on both scales. I therefore used score()",
    "with summary = FALSE for every landmark, method, and bootstrap sample,",
    "which kept the estimator identical across the comparison."
  )
}

knitr::kable(score_agreement, digits = 16)
cat(scoring_decision)
```

## Existing summary-metric behavior

The current summary implementation assumes that the first landmark contains
every subject who appears later. That assumption holds after a shared
enrollment origin but fails under staggered age entry. I retained the exact
age-scale failure and the pending analytic variance statement.

These summary values answer different prediction questions in different

## Harrell-bootstrap optimism correction

The bootstrap used `r n_boot` subject resamples and seed `r bootstrap_seed`.
The transformations, landmarks, and prediction window stayed fixed at their
original values.

```{r harrell-bootstrap, cache=FALSE}
build_analysis_stacks <- function(longitudinal_data) {
  enrollment_raw <- stack_data(
    data = longitudinal_data,
    outcome = list(time = "time", status = "status"),
    lms = enrollment_landmarks, w = prediction_window,
    covs = list(
      fixed = c(shared_fixed_covariates, "age_at_enrollment"),
      varying = updated_laboratory_covariates
    ),
    format = "long", id = "id", rtime = "tstart"
  )
  enrollment_raw$data$attained_age_z <- (
    enrollment_raw$data$age_at_enrollment + enrollment_raw$data$LM - age_center
  ) / age_scale

  age_long <- transform(
    longitudinal_data,
    entry_age = age_at_enrollment,
    exit_age = age_at_enrollment + time,
    visit_age = age_at_enrollment + tstart
  )
  age_raw <- stack_data(
    data = age_long,
    outcome = list(time = "exit_age", status = "status"),
    lms = age_landmarks, w = prediction_window,
    covs = list(
      fixed = shared_fixed_covariates,
      varying = updated_laboratory_covariates
    ),
    format = "long", id = "id", rtime = "visit_age",
    entry = "entry_age", entry_mode = "strict"
  )

  enrollment_model <- add_interactions(
    enrollment_raw,
    lm_covs = updated_laboratory_covariates,
    func_covars = enrollment_basis,
    func_lms = enrollment_basis
  )
  age_model <- add_interactions(
    age_raw,
    lm_covs = updated_laboratory_covariates,
    func_covars = age_basis,
    func_lms = list()
  )
  stopifnot(
    identical(
      prediction_key(enrollment_raw$data),
      prediction_key(enrollment_model$data)
    ),
    identical(prediction_key(age_raw$data), prediction_key(age_model$data)),
    anyDuplicated(enrollment_raw$data[c("id", "LM")]) == 0L,
    anyDuplicated(enrollment_model$data[c("id", "LM")]) == 0L,
    anyDuplicated(age_raw$data[c("id", "LM")]) == 0L,
    anyDuplicated(age_model$data[c("id", "LM")]) == 0L
  )
  list(
    enrollment_raw = enrollment_raw, enrollment_model = enrollment_model,
    age_raw = age_raw, age_model = age_model
  )
}

resample_subjects <- function(longitudinal_data, sampled_ids) {
  pieces <- lapply(seq_along(sampled_ids), function(index) {
    subject_rows <- longitudinal_data[
      longitudinal_data$id == sampled_ids[index], , drop = FALSE
    ]
    stopifnot(nrow(subject_rows) > 0L)
    subject_rows$.bootstrap_source_id <- subject_rows$id
    subject_rows$id <- index
    subject_rows
  })
  out <- do.call(rbind, pieces)
  rownames(out) <- NULL
  stopifnot(
    length(unique(out$id)) == length(sampled_ids),
    all(vapply(
      split(out$.bootstrap_source_id, out$id),
      function(source_ids) length(unique(source_ids)) == 1L,
      logical(1L)
    ))
  )
  out$.bootstrap_source_id <- NULL
  out
}

fit_bootstrap_disjoint <- function(lmdata, landmarks, formula) {
  setNames(lapply(landmarks, function(landmark) {
    capture_conditions(dynamic_lm(
      subset_lmdata(lmdata, landmark), formula,
      type = "CSC", method = "breslow", x = TRUE
    ))
  }), as.character(landmarks))
}

bind_non_null <- function(objects) {
  objects <- objects[!vapply(objects, is.null, logical(1L))]
  if (length(objects)) do.call(rbind, objects) else NULL
}

score_prediction_diagnostic <- function(prediction, landmark) {
  record <- capture_conditions(score(
    list(Model = prediction), times = landmark,
    metrics = c("auc", "brier"), id_col = "id",
    cause = cause_of_interest, summary = FALSE, contrasts = FALSE
  ))
  if (inherits(record$value, "error")) {
    return(list(ok = FALSE, error = conditionMessage(record$value)))
  }
  auc <- as.data.frame(record$value$AUC$score)
  brier <- as.data.frame(record$value$Brier$score)
  auc <- auc[as.character(auc$model) == "Model", , drop = FALSE]
  brier <- brier[as.character(brier$model) == "Model", , drop = FALSE]
  ok <- nrow(auc) == 1L && nrow(brier) == 1L &&
    is.finite(auc$AUC) && is.finite(brier$Brier)
  list(ok = ok, error = if (ok) "" else "non-finite or missing score")
}

direct_age_cause_fit <- function(lmdata, formula, cause) {
  rhs <- paste(deparse(formula[[3L]]), collapse = "")
  direct_formula <- as.formula(paste0(
    "Surv(LM, exit_age, status == ", cause, ") ~ ", rhs
  ))
  capture_conditions(survival::coxph(
    direct_formula, data = lmdata$data, method = "breslow", x = TRUE
  ))
}

diagnose_age_fit <- function(fit_record, training_stack, formula, landmarks,
                             replicate, method) {
  rows <- list()
  model_error <- if (inherits(fit_record$value, "error")) {
    conditionMessage(fit_record$value)
  } else ""

  for (landmark in landmarks) {
    one_landmark <- subset_lmdata(training_stack, landmark)
    for (cause in c(transplant_code, cause_of_interest)) {
      event_count <- sum(one_landmark$data$status == cause)
      cause_fit <- NULL
      coefficient_names <- character()
      if (!inherits(fit_record$value, "error")) {
        cause_fit <- extract_cause_fit(fit_record$value, cause)
        coefficient_names <- names(coef(cause_fit))[!is.finite(coef(cause_fit))]
      }
      needs_direct_check <- inherits(fit_record$value, "error") ||
        length(fit_record$warnings) > 0L || length(coefficient_names) > 0L
      direct_record <- if (needs_direct_check) {
        direct_age_cause_fit(training_stack, formula, cause)
      } else NULL
      cause_error <- if (!is.null(direct_record) &&
                         inherits(direct_record$value, "error")) {
        conditionMessage(direct_record$value)
      } else ""
      cause_warning <- if (!is.null(direct_record)) {
        paste(direct_record$warnings, collapse = " | ")
      } else ""
      if (!is.null(direct_record) && !inherits(direct_record$value, "error")) {
        direct_coefficients <- coef(direct_record$value)
        coefficient_names <- union(
          coefficient_names,
          names(direct_coefficients)[!is.finite(direct_coefficients)]
        )
      }
      cause_event_times <- training_stack$data$exit_age[
        training_stack$data$status == cause
      ]
      last_event_time <- if (length(cause_event_times)) {
        max(cause_event_times)
      } else NA_real_
      horizon <- landmark + prediction_window
      rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
        replicate = replicate,
        method = method,
        landmark = landmark,
        cause = cause,
        events = event_count,
        model_fit_error = model_error,
        cause_fit_error = cause_error,
        cause_fit_warning = cause_warning,
        nonfinite_coefficients = paste(coefficient_names, collapse = ", "),
        horizon = horizon,
        last_event_time = last_event_time,
        horizon_past_last_event = is.finite(last_event_time) &&
          horizon > last_event_time,
        row.names = NULL
      )
    }
  }
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

diagnose_age_predictions <- function(fit_record, training_stack, test_stack,
                                     landmarks, replicate, method) {
  rows <- list()
  model_error <- inherits(fit_record$value, "error")
  predictions <- list()
  for (sample_name in c("bootstrap_train", "original_test")) {
    target <- if (sample_name == "bootstrap_train") training_stack else test_stack
    predictions[[sample_name]] <- if (model_error) {
      list(value = fit_record$value, warnings = character(), messages = character())
    } else {
      capture_conditions(predict(
        fit_record$value, newdata = target, cause = cause_of_interest,
        complete = FALSE
      ))
    }
  }

  for (landmark in landmarks) {
    row <- data.frame(
      replicate = replicate,
      method = method,
      landmark = landmark,
      train_prediction_error = "",
      test_prediction_error = "",
      train_na_predictions = NA_integer_,
      test_na_predictions = NA_integer_,
      train_scoring_error = "",
      test_scoring_error = "",
      row.names = NULL
    )
    for (sample_name in names(predictions)) {
      prefix <- if (sample_name == "bootstrap_train") "train" else "test"
      prediction_record <- predictions[[sample_name]]
      if (inherits(prediction_record$value, "error")) {
        row[[paste0(prefix, "_prediction_error")]] <-
          conditionMessage(prediction_record$value)
        next
      }
      prediction <- subset_prediction(prediction_record$value, landmark)
      na_predictions <- sum(is.na(prediction$preds$risk))
      row[[paste0(prefix, "_na_predictions")]] <- na_predictions
      score_record <- if (na_predictions > 0L) {
        list(ok = FALSE, error = "NA predictions")
      } else {
        score_prediction_diagnostic(prediction, landmark)
      }
      row[[paste0(prefix, "_scoring_error")]] <- score_record$error
    }
    rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- row
  }
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

diagnose_age_model <- function(fit_record, training_stack, test_stack, formula,
                               landmarks, replicate, method) {
  list(
    fit = diagnose_age_fit(
      fit_record, training_stack, formula, landmarks, replicate, method
    ),
    prediction = diagnose_age_predictions(
      fit_record, training_stack, test_stack, landmarks, replicate, method
    )
  )
}

score_one_prediction <- function(prediction, landmark) {
  record <- capture_conditions(score(
    list(Model = prediction), times = landmark,
    metrics = c("auc", "brier"), id_col = "id",
    cause = cause_of_interest, summary = FALSE, contrasts = FALSE
  ))
  if (inherits(record$value, "error")) return(NULL)
  auc <- as.data.frame(record$value$AUC$score)
  brier <- as.data.frame(record$value$Brier$score)
  auc$model <- as.character(auc$model)
  brier$model <- as.character(brier$model)
  auc <- auc[auc$model == "Model", ]
  brier <- brier[brier$model == "Model", ]
  if (nrow(auc) != 1L || nrow(brier) != 1L ||
      !is.finite(auc$AUC) || !is.finite(brier$Brier)) return(NULL)
  data.frame(AUC = auc$AUC, Brier = brier$Brier)
}

evaluate_supermodel_bootstrap <- function(fit_record, training_stack,
                                          test_stack, landmarks,
                                          replicate, scale_label) {
  if (inherits(fit_record$value, "error")) return(NULL)
  training_prediction <- capture_conditions(predict(
    fit_record$value, newdata = training_stack, cause = cause_of_interest
  ))
  test_prediction <- capture_conditions(predict(
    fit_record$value, newdata = test_stack, cause = cause_of_interest
  ))
  if (inherits(training_prediction$value, "error") ||
      inherits(test_prediction$value, "error")) return(NULL)

  rows <- list()
  for (landmark in landmarks) {
    for (sample_name in c("bootstrap_train", "original_test")) {
      prediction <- if (sample_name == "bootstrap_train") {
        training_prediction$value
      } else test_prediction$value
      metric <- score_one_prediction(
        subset_prediction(prediction, landmark), landmark
      )
      if (!is.null(metric)) {
        rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
          replicate = replicate, scale = scale_label,
          method = "Supermodel", landmark = landmark,
          sample = sample_name, AUC = metric$AUC, Brier = metric$Brier
        )
      }
    }
  }
  if (length(rows)) do.call(rbind, rows) else NULL
}

evaluate_disjoint_bootstrap <- function(fit_records, training_stack,
                                        test_stack, landmarks,
                                        replicate, scale_label) {
  rows <- list()
  for (landmark in landmarks) {
    record <- fit_records[[as.character(landmark)]]
    if (inherits(record$value, "error")) next
    training_prediction <- capture_conditions(predict(
      record$value, newdata = subset_lmdata(training_stack, landmark),
      cause = cause_of_interest
    ))
    test_prediction <- capture_conditions(predict(
      record$value, newdata = subset_lmdata(test_stack, landmark),
      cause = cause_of_interest
    ))
    predictions <- list(
      bootstrap_train = training_prediction,
      original_test = test_prediction
    )
    for (sample_name in names(predictions)) {
      prediction_record <- predictions[[sample_name]]
      if (inherits(prediction_record$value, "error")) next
      metric <- score_one_prediction(prediction_record$value, landmark)
      if (!is.null(metric)) {
        rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
          replicate = replicate, scale = scale_label,
          method = "Disjoint", landmark = landmark,
          sample = sample_name, AUC = metric$AUC, Brier = metric$Brier
        )
      }
    }
  }
  if (length(rows)) do.call(rbind, rows) else NULL
}

original_stacks <- list(
  enrollment_raw = enrollment_stack_raw,
  enrollment_model = enrollment_stack,
  age_raw = age_stack_raw,
  age_model = age_stack
)

set.seed(bootstrap_seed)
original_ids <- unique(pbc_analysis$id)
bootstrap_samples <- lapply(seq_len(n_boot), function(replicate) {
  sample(original_ids, length(original_ids), replace = TRUE)
})

run_bootstrap_replicate <- function(replicate) {
  bootstrap_long_record <- capture_conditions(resample_subjects(
    pbc_analysis, bootstrap_samples[[replicate]]
  ))
  if (inherits(bootstrap_long_record$value, "error")) {
    return(list(
      scores = NULL,
      stack = data.frame(
        replicate = replicate,
        resample_error = conditionMessage(bootstrap_long_record$value),
        stack_build_error = "",
        age_raw_duplicate_id_lm = NA_integer_,
        age_model_duplicate_id_lm = NA_integer_
      ),
      fit = NULL, prediction = NULL, unexpected = NULL
    ))
  }
  stacks_record <- capture_conditions(build_analysis_stacks(
    bootstrap_long_record$value
  ))
  if (inherits(stacks_record$value, "error")) {
    return(list(
      scores = NULL,
      stack = data.frame(
        replicate = replicate,
        resample_error = "",
        stack_build_error = conditionMessage(stacks_record$value),
        age_raw_duplicate_id_lm = NA_integer_,
        age_model_duplicate_id_lm = NA_integer_
      ),
      fit = NULL, prediction = NULL, unexpected = NULL
    ))
  }
  stacks <- stacks_record$value
  stack_diagnostic <- data.frame(
    replicate = replicate,
    resample_error = "",
    stack_build_error = "",
    age_raw_duplicate_id_lm = anyDuplicated(
      stacks$age_raw$data[c("id", "LM")]
    ),
    age_model_duplicate_id_lm = anyDuplicated(
      stacks$age_model$data[c("id", "LM")]
    )
  )

  enrollment_super_fit <- capture_conditions(dynamic_lm(
    stacks$enrollment_model, enrollment_formula,
    type = "CSC", method = "breslow", x = TRUE
  ))
  age_super_fit <- capture_conditions(dynamic_lm(
    stacks$age_model, age_formula,
    type = "CSC", method = "breslow", x = TRUE
  ))
  enrollment_disjoint_fits <- fit_bootstrap_disjoint(
    stacks$enrollment_raw, enrollment_landmarks,
    enrollment_disjoint_formula
  )
  age_disjoint_fits <- fit_bootstrap_disjoint(
    stacks$age_raw, age_landmarks, age_disjoint_formula
  )

  score_rows <- list(
    evaluate_supermodel_bootstrap(
      enrollment_super_fit, stacks$enrollment_model,
      original_stacks$enrollment_model, enrollment_landmarks,
      replicate, "Enrollment time"
    ),
    evaluate_disjoint_bootstrap(
      enrollment_disjoint_fits, stacks$enrollment_raw,
      original_stacks$enrollment_raw, enrollment_landmarks,
      replicate, "Enrollment time"
    ),
    evaluate_supermodel_bootstrap(
      age_super_fit, stacks$age_model, original_stacks$age_model,
      age_landmarks, replicate, "Attained age"
    ),
    evaluate_disjoint_bootstrap(
      age_disjoint_fits, stacks$age_raw, original_stacks$age_raw,
      age_landmarks, replicate, "Attained age"
    )
  )
  super_diagnostic <- diagnose_age_model(
    age_super_fit, stacks$age_model, original_stacks$age_model,
    age_formula, age_landmarks, replicate, "Supermodel"
  )
  disjoint_diagnostics <- lapply(age_landmarks, function(landmark) {
    diagnose_age_model(
      age_disjoint_fits[[as.character(landmark)]],
      subset_lmdata(stacks$age_raw, landmark),
      subset_lmdata(original_stacks$age_raw, landmark),
      age_disjoint_formula, landmark, replicate, "Disjoint"
    )
  })

  list(
    scores = bind_non_null(score_rows),
    stack = stack_diagnostic,
    fit = bind_non_null(c(
      list(super_diagnostic$fit),
      lapply(disjoint_diagnostics, `[[`, "fit")
    )),
    prediction = bind_non_null(c(
      list(super_diagnostic$prediction),
      lapply(disjoint_diagnostics, `[[`, "prediction")
    )),
    unexpected = NULL
  )
}

bootstrap_cores <- getOption(
  "timescale.bootstrap.cores",
  if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") 1L else min(4L, parallel::detectCores(logical = FALSE))
)
safe_bootstrap_replicate <- function(replicate) {
  tryCatch(
    run_bootstrap_replicate(replicate),
    error = function(error) list(
      scores = NULL, stack = NULL, fit = NULL, prediction = NULL,
      unexpected = data.frame(
        replicate = replicate,
        error = conditionMessage(error),
        row.names = NULL
      )
    )
  )
}
if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows" || bootstrap_cores <= 1L) {
  bootstrap_results <- lapply(seq_len(n_boot), safe_bootstrap_replicate)
} else {
  bootstrap_results <- parallel::mclapply(
    seq_len(n_boot), safe_bootstrap_replicate,
    mc.cores = bootstrap_cores, mc.preschedule = FALSE
  )
}
bootstrap_scores <- bind_non_null(lapply(bootstrap_results, `[[`, "scores"))
age_stack_diagnostics <- bind_non_null(lapply(bootstrap_results, `[[`, "stack"))
age_fit_diagnostics <- bind_non_null(lapply(bootstrap_results, `[[`, "fit"))
age_prediction_diagnostics <- bind_non_null(lapply(
  bootstrap_results, `[[`, "prediction"
))
unexpected_bootstrap_errors <- bind_non_null(lapply(

))
stopifnot(!is.null(bootstrap_scores))
rownames(bootstrap_scores) <- NULL

  bootstrap_scores$sample == "bootstrap_train",

]
bootstrap_test <- bootstrap_scores[

bootstrap_optimism <- do.call(rbind, lapply(
  split(paired_bootstrap, list(
    paired_bootstrap$scale, paired_bootstrap$method,
    paired_bootstrap$landmark
  ), drop = TRUE),
  function(rows) {
    auc_optimism <- rows$AUC_train - rows$AUC_test
    brier_optimism <- rows$Brier_train - rows$Brier_test
    data.frame(
      scale = rows$scale[1L], method = rows$method[1L],
      landmark = rows$landmark[1L],
      successful_replicates = length(unique(rows$replicate)),
      failed_replicates = n_boot - length(unique(rows$replicate)),
      mean_AUC_optimism = mean(auc_optimism),
      Monte_Carlo_SE_AUC_optimism = sd(auc_optimism) / sqrt(length(auc_optimism)),
      mean_Brier_optimism = mean(brier_optimism),
      Monte_Carlo_SE_Brier_optimism = sd(brier_optimism) / sqrt(length(brier_optimism)),
      row.names = NULL
    )
  }
))
rownames(bootstrap_optimism) <- NULL

optimism_corrected_performance <- merge(
  apparent_performance, bootstrap_optimism,
  by = c("scale", "method", "landmark"), all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE
)
optimism_corrected_performance$successful_replicates[

optimism_corrected_performance$failed_replicates[

] <- n_boot
optimism_corrected_performance$optimism_corrected_AUC <- with(
  optimism_corrected_performance, AUC - mean_AUC_optimism
)
optimism_corrected_performance$optimism_corrected_Brier <- with(
  optimism_corrected_performance, Brier - mean_Brier_optimism
)

stopifnot(
  all(optimism_corrected_performance$successful_replicates >= 0L),
  all(optimism_corrected_performance$failed_replicates >= 0L),
  all(optimism_corrected_performance$failed_replicates <= n_boot),
  all(
    optimism_corrected_performance$successful_replicates +
      optimism_corrected_performance$failed_replicates == n_boot
  )
)

age_stack_summary <- data.frame(

failure_reason_rows <- list()
normalize_failure_reason <- function(reason) {
  if (grepl("^arguments imply differing number of rows:", reason)) {
    return("zero-event model returned no coefficient rows")
  }
  if (grepl("infinite argument in coxph.wtest", reason, fixed = TRUE)) {
    return("Cox Wald calculation had an infinite argument")
  }
  if (grepl("Ran out of iterations", reason, fixed = TRUE)) {
    return("Cox fit did not converge")
  }
  if (grepl("beta may be infinite", reason, fixed = TRUE)) {
    return("one or more Cox coefficients may be infinite")
  }
  reason
}
append_failure_reason <- function(method, landmark, cause, stage, reason) {
  failure_reason_rows[[length(failure_reason_rows) + 1L]] <<- data.frame(
    method = method,
    landmark = landmark,
    cause = as.character(cause),
    stage = stage,
    reason = normalize_failure_reason(reason),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
for (row_index in seq_len(nrow(age_fit_diagnostics))) {
  row <- age_fit_diagnostics[row_index, ]
  if (row$events == 0L) {
    append_failure_reason(
      row$method, row$landmark, row$cause,
      "event count", "zero events inside the prediction window"
    )
  }
  if (nzchar(row$model_fit_error)) {
    append_failure_reason(
      row$method, row$landmark, row$cause,
      "competing-risk fit", row$model_fit_error
    )
  }
  if (nzchar(row$cause_fit_error)) {
    append_failure_reason(
      row$method, row$landmark, row$cause,
      "cause-specific fit", row$cause_fit_error
    )
  }
  if (nzchar(row$cause_fit_warning)) {
    append_failure_reason(
      row$method, row$landmark, row$cause,
      "cause-specific fit", row$cause_fit_warning
    )
  }
  if (nzchar(row$nonfinite_coefficients)) {
    append_failure_reason(
      row$method, row$landmark, row$cause,
      "cause-specific fit",
      "one or more non-finite coefficients"
    )
  }
}
for (row_index in seq_len(nrow(age_prediction_diagnostics))) {
  row <- age_prediction_diagnostics[row_index, ]
  prediction_fields <- c(
    train_prediction_error = "train prediction",
    test_prediction_error = "test prediction",
    train_scoring_error = "train scoring",
    test_scoring_error = "test scoring"
  )
  for (field in names(prediction_fields)) {
    if (nzchar(row[[field]])) {
      append_failure_reason(
        row$method, row$landmark, "joint CIF",
        unname(prediction_fields[field]), row[[field]]
      )
    }
  }
  if (is.finite(row$train_na_predictions) && row$train_na_predictions > 0L) {
    append_failure_reason(
      row$method, row$landmark, "joint CIF",
      "train prediction", "one or more NA risks"
    )
  }
  if (is.finite(row$test_na_predictions) && row$test_na_predictions > 0L) {
    append_failure_reason(
      row$method, row$landmark, "joint CIF",
      "test prediction", "one or more NA risks"
    )
  }
}
age_failure_reason_tally <- aggregate(
  list(replicates = rep(1L, length(failure_reason_rows))),
  by = do.call(rbind, failure_reason_rows),
  FUN = sum
)
age_failure_reason_tally <- age_failure_reason_tally[
  order(
    age_failure_reason_tally$method,
    age_failure_reason_tally$landmark,
    age_failure_reason_tally$cause,
    age_failure_reason_tally$stage,
    age_failure_reason_tally$reason
  ),
]

)

))

)

] <- FALSE
age_horizon_link <- merge(

enrollment_super_replicates_retained <- length(unique(
  paired_bootstrap$replicate[
    paired_bootstrap$scale == "Enrollment time" &
      paired_bootstrap$method == "Supermodel" &
      paired_bootstrap$landmark == enrollment_landmarks[1L]
  ]
))

age_performance_pair_counts <- optimism_corrected_performance[
  optimism_corrected_performance$scale == "Attained age",
  c("method", "landmark", "successful_replicates")
]
age_pair_count_validation <- merge(
  age_score_pair_counts, age_performance_pair_counts,
```
